name: Obat Helpers
mission: Our mission is to equip underserved communities in Bangladesh with the tools they need to break free from the cycle of poverty. We do this by providing access to quality education and economic empowerment programs, promoting financial independence and inclusive economic growth. Our ultimate goal is to build a more equitable and prosperous Bangladesh for all.

strengths_deep_dive: Obat Helpers demonstrates strong operational efficiency and high programmatic impact in serving displaced communities in Bangladesh. The organization achieved <cite id="1">a 90.3/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite> and operates with <cite id="1">a program expense ratio of 82.1% in FY2024</cite>, exceeding the standard 75% benchmark. According to recent reporting, their direct service delivery model enabled them to benefit <cite id="6">9,836 students, treat 8,646 individuals in health clinics, and serve 13,703 families</cite>. Governance is supported by an independent board and a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid.
rich_narrative.summary: Obat Helpers works to break the cycle of poverty for displaced and refugee communities in Bangladesh through empowerment, education, and healthcare initiatives. Operating as an established organization founded in 2004, the non-profit maintains <cite id="1">a 90.3/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>. The organization's programs provide direct direct-service interventions, reaching vulnerable populations including Rohingya refugees and displaced camp residents. In FY2024, Obat Helpers managed <cite id="12">$1,591,131 in total revenue</cite>, down from <cite id="3">$2,184,558 in FY2023</cite>. Despite this revenue decline, the organization maintained strong direct program operations, achieving a high <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 82.1%</cite>. Their efficiency metrics show a low fundraising cost of <cite id="1">$0.06 per $1 raised</cite>, keeping overhead low while maximizing direct assistance. As a <cite id="2">zakat-eligible organization</cite>, Obat Helpers serves qualifying asnaf including the poor (fuqara) and needy (masakin), offering donors a reliable vehicle for faith-aligned giving.
